sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: French studio SAM Architecture has created the Yvonne Kerzrého School Complex in Nanterre, France, arranging classrooms around cascading terraces and courtyards that extend learning outdoors. The 4,856-square-metre building accommodates a nursery, primary school, after-school care centre, media library and cafeteria, all within a single facility in Paris's rapidly developing Les Groues district.
